name: Lightwell Proactive Update Orchestrator
description: Proactive dependency remediation. Trigger is a Lightwell remediated package landing in the Artifactory lightwell-remediated repo (NOT a CVE alert). Phase 1: Concert SBOM inventory + Arena View topology, then AI impact triage decides the route. Phase 2a: auto-update path (git bump -> Tekton build -> ArgoCD sync -> validate -> Concert write-back). Phase 2b: downstream consumers exist, human approval before the same path. Phase 2c: non-production only, schedule for the next window. Phase 2d: portfolio not affected, log only. LLM: drc maas sonnet 4.6. NOTE: this file is the provisioning TEMPLATE. lab/setup/configure-ao.yml rewrites it per student at lab build time: it registers the student's AAP as an AO integration, resolves job_template_id 9001-9006 by matching job_template_name, rewrites integration_id and credential_id on every AAP node, suffixes the trigger webhook_path with the lab id, and publishes the result. The ids committed here are placeholders bound to an unreachable integration, so an unmodified import cannot execute against the wrong template.
